assessment: While immune checkpoint inhibitors (anti-PD-1 targeted agents) are now FDA-approved for the treatment of locally advanced and recurrent or metastatic head and neck cancer, predictive biomarkers are lacking. In this study, the co-authors have developed an algorithm that they conclude predicts the clinical outcome to multimodality immunotherapy. While this machine learning approach is intriguing, prospective validation of the proposed immune-based signature is essential to begin to incorporate such an approach into the clinic.
